documents.name: Paper sculpture.md
documents.text:
# A loop sculpture
## Assembly
Fold each of six paper strips into a loop and join neighbouring loops using clips. Arrange the connected loops on a flat surface.
## Limits
The directions describe assembly but supply no dimensions, material masses or final weight. No measurement method for weight is specified.

documents.name: Sensor workflow.md
documents.text:
# Sensor record workflow
## Preparing the records
Import the CSV file. Exclude rows whose voltage field is empty, and plot the remaining voltage readings against their timestamps. Keep the original CSV unchanged.
## Calibration gap
The notes contain no calibration equation or conversion factors from voltage to temperature. They do not provide a temperature series.

# Community memo brief
## Draft structure
Start with a title naming the issue. Write one paragraph describing the issue, then a section collecting available evidence. Finish with a proposed action and a list of unresolved questions.
## Unspecified resources
The brief does not specify a project budget, funding source or application deadline.

documents.text:
# Cloud biscuits
## Preparation
Mix 100 grams of flour with 60 grams of water. Shape six biscuits and bake at 200 degrees Celsius for 12 minutes.
## Missing analysis
This fictional card supplies no nutritional analysis or calorie values. It contains no method for computing them.
